scope: Windows Tauri/WebView2 evidence review; existing root CUA observations only

environment.credential_backend: process-local keyring mock; no system persistence claim
environment.frontend_identity_note: Native binary and later frontend builds are separate layers. IME wait/switch records identify frontend 648; final cursor records identify 650; earlier native screenshots have no explicit frontend build label.

native_cases.name: Quick typing followed by native Save
actions: Type Chinese, emoji, Markdown table and code whitespace into the dedicated QA note
Save immediately after typing
observed: Chinese and emoji present on disk
Two-space indentation and code blank lines preserved
QA file content and SHA256 recorded
limits: Single QA sample; does not establish native UTF-16/BOM/CRLF matrix or a paused-write typing race

native_cases.name: Clean native tab reloads external changes
actions: Modify the QA file externally while its clean native tab remains open
observed: External-change sentence becomes visible in the native editor
limits: One observed external update; not sustained filesystem event stress

native_cases.name: External change immediately after an own save
actions: Observe an own save on the host
Write AFTER_SAVE_EXTERNAL_MARKER into the QA file 1ms later
observed: Native editor shows AFTER_SAVE_EXTERNAL_MARKER
limits: Delay is measured from host observation, not atomic-write internals or event delivery
One sequence, not simultaneous CAS stress or arbitrary scheduling proof

native_cases.name: Save notification reaches another native window
actions: Open the same QA file in a second native window
Save CROSS_WINDOW_MAIN_SAVE in the main window
observed: Second window displays CROSS_WINDOW_MAIN_SAVE
native_cases.root_confirmation: Root explicitly confirmed main-save to auxiliary-refresh direction during evidence review
limits: Sequential main-to-auxiliary notification, not two dirty windows saving from the same baseline simultaneously

native_cases.name: Closing another window retains the main watcher
actions: Close the auxiliary native window
Modify the same QA file externally
observed: Main window displays AFTER_SECOND_WINDOW_CLOSED
native_cases.root_confirmation: Root confirmed this lifecycle sequence during evidence review
limits: Does not cover different spelling/Unicode aliases, two processes, or dirty auxiliary close behavior

native_cases.name: Escape cancels a dirty external-change conflict safely
actions: Type UNSAVED_LOCAL_MARKER locally without saving
Modify the QA file externally
Press Escape on the conflict dialog
observed: Local draft and dirty indicator remain visible
Disk still contains the external version
Unsaved local draft is not written to disk
native_cases.root_confirmation: Root explicitly identified Escape as the cancellation gesture
limits: Does not exercise the reload-from-disk branch

native_cases.name: Save reopens the conflict and explicit overwrite writes only the QA draft
actions: After Escape cancellation, press Ctrl+S
Choose Overwrite external changes on the renewed conflict dialog
observed: Conflict reappears instead of silently overwriting
Local draft is then on disk by explicit choice
External sentinel removed and committed Chinese retained
native_cases.root_confirmation: Root confirmed Ctrl+S reopening and the explicit overwrite button; only the dedicated QA note was changed
limits: No additional external write during the dialog/CAS interval was injected

native_cases.name: One Ctrl+S waits for genuine Microsoft Pinyin commit
actions: Open the Microsoft Pinyin ni'hao candidate
Press Ctrl+S once while composition is active
Commit with Space
Do not send a second Save
observed: Prefix and partial pinyin not written before commit
Complete Chinese saved after commit
Recorded secondSaveSent=false and savedOnlyAfterCommit=true
limits: One Microsoft Pinyin path, not Sogou/Japanese/Korean/voice/cancellation matrix
Custom Save shortcuts and Meta save have module evidence, not this native UI run

native_cases.name: Committed Chinese remains with its original tab after immediate new-tab creation
actions: Commit Chinese text
Immediately create a new tab
observed: New tab body is blank
Committed Chinese remains saved to the original QA file
The screenshot also exposes the old 33:15 status on the blank tab; W10 verifies its fix
limits: This is commit-then-switch, not comprehensive switching during uncommitted composition
The JSON passed=true covers body/file identity, not the old cursor display

native_cases.name: Native tab cursor display matches actual blank/restored state
actions: Observe original tab at line 33 column 15
Switch to blank Untitled
Return to original tab
observed: Blank displays line 1 column 1 and wordCount 0
Original tab restores line 33 column 15
limits: Selected-character display and all selection branches are not independently demonstrated by these three screenshots; actual SFC/CM state regressions cover clearing old selection metadata

native_cases.name: Native desktop Markdown live/reading sample, local table scroll, table history and code reveal/save round-trip
actions: View Markdown table and ordinary Markdown/HTML fenced code in live mode
Scroll the table locally to reveal its final column
Insert right column, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Z
Click the second JS block, Enter, Ctrl+Z, save layout-native.md
View the saved document in reading mode
observed: Table last column reachable through local horizontal scroll
Ordinary fenced Markdown/HTML stays literal code
Column counts 3->4->3->4->3, timerStarted=false
Code click status line19 column1
Root recorded saved content exactly equal to fixture after Enter/undo
Reading screenshot preserves the table and literal code sample
limits: Native 1200x800 sample only; not narrow-window or four-code-setting native matrix
This is frontend650 evidence, not a replay on654
